rationale: True independent PO review. The delivery functionally works (publish → relay → launcher → COMPLETED) but acceptance criteria are only partially verified. Two criteria are missing (ACCEPTED/STARTED states never published to Redis), two checks are tautological/hardcoded (ACCEPTED assertion always True, no-external-effects is a literal True). The test reports 6/6 PASS but provides false confidence. The PR was already merged, so iteration requires a follow-up PR fixing these gaps.

accepted_state.evidence: Line 154: 'relay.returncode is not None' is ALWAYS True after subprocess.run(). Does not verify any ACCEPTED state in Redis. No ACCEPTED state is ever written by fleet_launcher.py or fleet_relay_v4_1.py.

started_state.evidence: Never published to Redis by fleet_launcher.py. Not checked in test. Completely absent from state machine.

completed_state.evidence: Line 119-122: inbox:<sender> contains result with state=COMPLETED

result_retrievable.evidence: Line 137-144: result:<task_id> readable via Redis GET

no_external_effects.evidence: Line 157: 'Sans effet externe': True — hardcoded boolean. No actual verification of git status, file writes, or network calls.
